evidence.name: SoundEffectTrigger

function_ir.summary: Computes a clamped ratio of two sub-struct floats (obj+0x39A0 over obj+0x39A4), mixes in two noise-table samples and a random pick, then calls HUDElementConfig with the resulting intensity parameters to configure an indexed HUD/sound element.

operations.description: Dereference *this to the sub-struct obj and compute v2 = obj+0x39A0 / obj+0x39A4.
Clamp the ratio v2 into [0, 1]: values below zero clamp to 0 and values above 1 clamp to 1.
Sample noise v4 = flt_8AB274[(byte)dword_8AAE70++] and compute v12 = ratio * 0.85 + 0.15 + v4 * 0.05.
Call RatioComputationWithClamping(obj+12) for a second clamped ratio value.

Sample a second noise value, pick an element index from the random result of RandLCGRandomNumberGenerator (12, 13, or 14 depending on ranges 10922/21844), and compute v11 = noise * 0.05 + (ratio - 0.25) * 0.5 + 1.0.
Return HUDElementConfig(this, picked index, 1, v12, v11).

unresolved: Global literals flt_59E43C, flt_59E440, flt_59E448, flt_59E450, flt_59E7F8, flt_59E868, flt_59E908 are listed in the packet's globals table but do not appear in the raw source; their role here is unclear.
The sub-struct behind *this (holding the ratio fields at obj+0x39A0/0x39A4 and extra data at obj+12) has an unknown type.
The mapping of the picked index (12/13/14) to a concrete HUD/sound element is unknown; the two callers are PositionLapStateUpdate (0x00447E00) and RaceStartCountdownStateUpdate (0x004EF930).
